f_pkg_mal_reversed_names: import and call built from reversed strings (`'so'[::-1]`); no static rule fired and the reviewer returned no claim.
f_pkg_mal_git_hook_plant: plants a git pre-commit hook that runs `curl | sh`; only the reviewer noticed (risk 30, and flagged needs more than 30).
f_pkg_mal_meta_path_hook: installs an import hook via `sys.meta_path.insert`; no static rule and no reviewer claim.
f_pkg_mal_beacon_thread: daemon thread polling a host every 60 s; only the reviewer noticed (risk 17, below threshold).
f_tool_mal_zero_width_split: zero-width characters inside a directive were detected (TOOL.DESC.INVISIBLE_UNICODE) but the score of 30 is not above the threshold (tools are quarantined by policy anyway).
f_tool_mal_output_injection: the injected text is in the tool's *return value*, which no scanner reads (description and code are scanned for capabilities, not for strings returned).
f_tool_mal_markdown_beacon: markdown image beacon in the tool's return value; same blind spot as the output-injection case.
f_tpl_mal_hidden_tool_call: the URL in the template was found (MODEL.TEMPLATE.URL) but the template scored only 15-20, below threshold; the hidden `<tool_call>` was not recognised as an instruction.
f_tpl_mal_user_as_system: renders user turns with the system role; nothing flags a role remap, only generic missing-card/parent findings.
f_tpl_mal_drop_system_on_key: template uses `{% continue %}` and failed to parse (MODEL.TEMPLATE.UNPARSEABLE), so its trigger-conditional system-prompt drop was never analysed; risk 27.
f_tok_swap_special_flag_flipped: tokenizer diff does not compare the `special` flag of added tokens, so the flipped flag produced no finding.
f_pkg_ok_keyed_client: legitimate API client that reads `SERVICE_API_KEY` and sends it as a bearer token to its own API host; statically identical to credential exfiltration (ENV_EXFIL + CREDENTIAL_EXFIL), and the reviewer added a claim on top.

paramiko: static DELAYED_EXEC (critical) on ordinary timeout checks (`max_ts <= time.time()` -> 'Authentication timeout', `start_ts + timeout < time.time()` -> 'Timeout opening channel'), i.e. time comparisons, not a time bomb.

sentry-sdk: reviewer only: three high claims (`git rev-parse` via subprocess, reading `SENTRY_DSN`, urllib3 network); static risk was 5, the claims pushed it to block (80). The SDK's whole purpose is to report over the network.
